database.description: When application surface discovery finds Prisma, Drizzle, Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Firebase persistence, ORM models, migrations, or database queries, or critical journeys mutate persistent data

critical_journeys_definition.description: Critical journeys are user workflows that span multiple components and require real browser interaction to verify. They are not unit tests or API checks.
mandatory_when_auth_exists: Session state verification — cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage contain auth markers
Dashboard/landing page reached after authentication — visible authenticated marker confirmed
mandatory_when_user_workflows_exist: Primary user workflow — the core action the product exists to perform (e.g., create order, submit form, process payment)
Error handling paths — negative tests with diagnostic evidence (console errors, failed requests, visible error state)
critical_journeys_definition.evidence_requirements: Each critical journey must produce: (1) at least 2 screenshots (key interaction + final state), (2) session state verification, (3) browser console check, (4) scenario JSON report validated by scripts/check-e2e-evidence.mjs. A screenshot-only check is NOT valid E2E evidence.

gate_contracts.outcome: verification report documents test results with actual execution evidence
evaluation report records pass/fail verdicts
verification report documents executed test results with pass/fail counts or coverage data
evaluation report records acceptance verdicts with traceability to requirements
quality audit verdict is recorded for phase artifacts
E2E test execution results exist with structured pass/fail data
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: do the E2E results cover critical user journeys? N/A for non-UI projects. The structural check verifies that E2E tests were executed and results recorded in structured format, not just mentioned in a report.

gate_contracts.outcome: runtime security scan report exists with severity-classified findings
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: do the security scan findings demonstrate adequate runtime coverage? N/A for projects with no security surface. The structural check verifies that a security scan was executed and findings recorded in structured format.

gate_contracts.outcome: quality audit report references specific file locations as evidence
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: do the cited locations correspond to meaningful review points? The structural check verifies the review engaged with specific code rather than producing a generic verdict.

gate_contracts.outcome: verification report includes structured test execution counts or coverage data
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: do the test counts reflect adequate coverage for the project scope? The structural check verifies the report includes quantitative test execution data rather than only qualitative statements.

gate_contracts.outcome: production readiness controls have evidence or substantive non-applicability justification
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the risk classification is appropriate and the cited evidence demonstrates operational readiness for the actual deployment environment.

gate_contracts.outcome: verification report records prior knowledge recall or online research evidence
verification report includes multi-dimensional quality evidence covering tests, performance, security, and maintainability
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the verification report includes evidence across at least four quality dimensions: functional correctness (tests), performance, security, and maintainability. Generic mentions without data are insufficient.

gate_contracts.outcome: website meets performance budget with Lighthouse score or load time evidence
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "(lighthouse|performance score|page speed|load time|FCP|LCP|CLS|TTFB|bundle size|gzip|compress|cache|cdn|core web vital)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the verification includes specific performance metrics (Lighthouse scores, load times, bundle sizes) — not just 'performance was checked'. N/A for non-website UI.

gate_contracts.outcome: API input validation tested with invalid, malformed, and malicious payloads
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "(input valid|invalid (input|payload|request)|malformed|boundary|edge case|sql injection|xss|csrf|negative test|400|422|error response|fuzz)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the API was tested with specifically invalid inputs — not just happy-path tests. N/A for non-API projects.

gate_contracts.outcome: database migration reversibility or backup procedure verified
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "(rollback|reversib|migrate down|backup|restore|point.in.time|dry.run|migration test|schema revert|idempoten)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the verification tested that migrations can be rolled back or that a backup exists. N/A for projects with no database.

gate_contracts.outcome: CLI tested with various argument combinations, invalid input, and help output
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "(--help|help output|argument|invalid input|exit code|stderr|missing arg|unknown flag|usage|subcommand|pipe)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the CLI was tested with valid args, invalid args, missing args, and --help. N/A for non-CLI projects.

gate_contracts.outcome: data quality validated across pipeline stages with source, transformation, and output checks
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "(data quality|source valid|schema check|type check|null check|dedup|drift|anomal|distribution|row count|checksum|expect|great.expect|dbt test)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm data quality checks exist at multiple pipeline stages — not just output validation. N/A for non-data projects.

gate_contracts.outcome: documentation links verified and code examples tested
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "(link check|broken link|code example|snippet test|runnable|copy.paste|markdown lint|mdx|build docs|doc.*test)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm links were checked and code examples were verified to work. N/A for non-documentation projects.

gate_contracts.outcome: plugin API contract verified stable and breaking changes documented
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "(api contract|public api|breaking change|backward compat|semver|version|export|interface|deprecat|peer depend|integration test)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the plugin's public API was tested for stability. N/A for non-plugin projects.

gate_contracts.outcome: verification report confirms dashboard loading, error, empty, and large-data states were tested
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "(loading state|skeleton|error state|empty state|no data|large data|pagination|virtuali[sz]ation|1000 rows|stress|slow network|throttl)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the dashboard was tested in loading, error, empty, and large-data states. N/A for non-dashboard UI.

gate_contracts.outcome: test report contains no fake or placeholder claims
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Validates semantic quality of evidence, not just presence/structure. Rejects weak evidence like 'Button works.', checks provenance for runtime claims, and detects static-vs-runtime contradictions. Exit code 0 = adequate, 1 = weak/contradictory evidence.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Verify test report contains actual test results, not generic claims like 'all tests pass' without evidence. Run `node scripts/validate-evidence-adequacy.mjs <project-root>` for automated semantic validation.

gate_contracts.outcome: verification evidence is not generic prose
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Validates semantic quality of evidence, not just presence/structure. Rejects weak evidence like 'Button works.', checks provenance for runtime claims, and detects static-vs-runtime contradictions. Exit code 0 = adequate, 1 = weak/contradictory evidence.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Ensure verification report contains specific evidence, not just 'looks good' or 'works fine' without data. Run `node scripts/validate-evidence-adequacy.mjs <project-root>` for automated semantic validation.

gate_contracts.outcome: output quality scorecard JSON records inspected artifact, evidence paths, defects, refinement actions, and final rating
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the scorecard JSON has specific evidence paths and actionable refinement actions - not generic 'looks good' claims. The structural check verifies the JSON exists with required fields; gate-check.mjs quality-scorecard validator enforces field content and UI-specific rules.

gate_contracts.outcome: high-impact UI quality scorecard includes a Design Benchmark Record tying screenshots and quality findings back to external benchmark decisions
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the final UI evidence actually reflects the benchmark decisions. The structural check validates source count, adopted patterns, local decisions, and rejects vague or Mobbin MCP-based evidence.

gate_contracts.outcome: E2E scenario reports exist with structured evidence (screenshots, checks, diagnostics) for critical user journeys
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Run `node scripts/check-e2e-evidence.mjs <each-scenario-report.json>` on every E2E scenario report. Each PASS report must have: 2+ screenshots under prime/test/screenshots/verify/, project analysis filled (not placeholders), all required checks true, and no secrets. Each FAIL report must retain screenshots and diagnostics. BLOCKED reports must state the prerequisite gap. A scenario that only captures one viewport screenshot is incomplete and must not count as PASS.

gate_contracts.outcome: every applicable TRACE_REQUIRED mutation has complete cross-layer evidence — frontend, backend, persistence, and UI result are all verified with no unexplained missing layers
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm each TRACE_REQUIRED item in the coverage map has at least one trace with frontend.status=verified, backend.status=verified, data.persistence_verified=true, and ui_result.refresh_verified=true. N/A for projects without persistence. See FULL-STACK-TRACE-PROTOCOL.md for trace levels and evidence requirements.

gate_contracts.outcome: data integrity verification exists for every data model — foreign keys, uniqueness, constraints, derived fields, totals, status consistency verified via direct database query where environment permits
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm each data model in the coverage map has a data_integrity object with pass/fail/not_tested for applicable checks. UI correctness alone is NOT evidence of data integrity — direct database verification is required where the environment permits. N/A for projects without persistence.

gate_contracts.outcome: verification report documents impact analysis of code changes — what changed, what observable behavior could regress, and what verification depth was selected — with evidence that selected verification was executed
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "(affected behavior|verification depth|impact analysis|changed behavior|regression|behavior preserv|refactor.*verif|verif.*refactor)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the verification report explicitly documents: (1) what code changed, (2) what observable behavior could be affected, (3) what verification depth was selected (static/unit/integration/E2E) and why, (4) evidence that the selected verification was executed. For simple changes, a brief assessment suffices. For critical-journey refactors, the report must show E2E or explain why E2E was not executable. Completion claims must not exceed available verification evidence. N/A only when no code was changed.

gate_contracts.outcome: verification report contains an Autopilot Depth Extensions section with pass/not_required/not_applicable status for each of the 6 depth capabilities and evidence or justification for each
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-6-verify.md "Autopilot Depth Extensions"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm each of the 6 depth extensions has a status entry: pass, not_required (with reason), or not_applicable (with reason). The structural check verifies the section exists; human review confirms the evidence is substantive. N/A for non-autopilot quality modes.

gate_contracts.outcome: security scan report covers all applicable OWASP Top 10 categories with evidence or explicit NOT_APPLICABLE justification for each missing category
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Cross-validates security-sensitive surfaces against test evidence: every AUTH_REQUIRED, ROLE_REQUIRED, TENANT_SCOPED, or RLS_POLICY boundary must have corresponding security test evidence in the coverage map. Unresolved critical/high findings from the security scan are also flagged.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm each OWASP category marked as verified has substantive test evidence, not just a checkbox. Categories marked NOT_APPLICABLE must have project-specific justification. N/A for projects with no security surface.

gate_contracts.outcome: ASVS compliance level selected (L1/L2/L3) and per-chapter verdicts recorded in security scan report
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the selected ASVS level matches the project risk profile: L1 for all projects, L2 for projects with auth/payments/PII, L3 for fintech/health/government. Per-chapter verdicts must exist for the selected level. N/A for projects with no security surface.

gate_contracts.outcome: runtime error detection report exists with structured error classification, startup verification, and provenance
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Starts the application server on an isolated available port, captures stderr/stdout for runtime errors (stack traces, uncaught exceptions, port conflicts, missing modules), verifies HTTP response, and produces a structured JSON report with provenance (command, URL, timestamp, exit code). Uses cross-platform process tree kill to ensure clean shutdown. Exit code 0 = no runtime errors, 1 = errors detected.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the runtime error report was generated from an actual server start with provenance fields (tool_identity, timestamp, start_command or url). The startup_success field must be true, http_status must be < 500, and error_count must be 0 for a pass. The structural validator checks startup_success, http_status, error_count, and verdict. N/A for non-server projects (libraries, CLIs without HTTP).

gate_contracts.outcome: browser console error report exists with console message classification, network failure analysis, and provenance
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Validates the browser console error report produced via Playwright MCP tools (browser_console_messages, browser_network_requests). Checks for uncaught exceptions, network failures, CORS errors, hydration errors, and framework-specific warnings. Requires at least one page checked with console_messages and network_failures arrays. Exit code 0 = no console errors, 1 = errors found.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the browser console report was filled using Playwright MCP tools against a running application, not fabricated. The pages_checked array must contain at least one page. The structural validator checks timestamp, url, pages_checked, console_messages, network_failures, and analysis verdict. N/A for non-UI projects.

gate_contracts.outcome: UI quality assessment report exists with multi-dimensional scoring, screenshot evidence, and provenance
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Validates the UI quality report produced via snapcheck MCP tools (verify_design, accessibility_audit, check_contrast, visual_regression, analyze_layout, check_responsive). Scores 5 quality dimensions: design tokens (25%), accessibility (25%), responsive layout (20%), visual consistency (15%), component quality (15%). Requires screenshots array with existing files. Exit code 0 = pass, 1 = critical issues.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the UI quality report was produced using snapcheck MCP tools against screenshots at desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports. Each of the 5 quality dimensions must have per-check pass/fail results. The structural validator checks dimensions, screenshots existence, and overall_score. N/A for non-UI projects.

gate_contracts.outcome: implementation quality aggregation report exists with weighted overall score, per-category verdicts, and fail-closed enforcement
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Aggregates all Phase 6 verification reports (runtime errors, browser console, UI quality, E2E results, security scan, quality scorecard, verification report) into a single quality assessment with weighted scoring. Fails closed when fewer than 4 assessments completed, runtime startup failed, browser checked 0 pages, or any assessment failed. Exit code 0 = all checks pass, 1 = one or more critical checks fail.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the implementation quality report aggregates evidence from at least 4 verification sources with fail_closed_reasons array empty or containing only acceptable justifications. The overall_score must be >= 60, verdict must be pass, and all applicable assessments must have status pass or warning. The structural validator checks verdict, overall_score, assessments completion, and fail-closed reasons.

gate_contracts.outcome: E2E evidence includes screenshots on disk, console log, and specific e2e tool identity
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Validates E2E evidence: requires screenshots on disk, console log capture, and specific e2e tool identity (playwright, cypress, or puppeteer — not the generic 'e2e-runner' family name). Cross-checks that referenced test files exist. Exit code 0 = evidence valid, 1 = evidence invalid or fabricated. N/A for non-UI projects.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the e2e screenshots were captured during actual browser test execution, not fabricated. The tool_identity must be playwright, cypress, or puppeteer (not the generic 'e2e-runner' family name). N/A for non-UI projects.

gate_contracts.outcome: a11y evidence includes known tool identity, evidence paths on disk, and tool output
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Validates a11y evidence: requires known tool identity (axe, lighthouse, pa11y, or snapcheck — not the generic 'accessibility-auditor' family name), evidence paths that exist on disk, and tool output. Manual-only claims without tool evidence are rejected. Exit code 0 = evidence valid, 1 = evidence invalid or fabricated. N/A for non-UI projects.
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the a11y audit was produced by axe, lighthouse, pa11y, or snapcheck against the actual application. Manual-only claims without tool evidence are rejected. N/A for non-UI projects.
